prompt: I have 4 inboxes on one domain each sending 25 a day. Is that safe?

assertions.name: flags-domain-aggregate
assertions.check: Identifies 100/day on one domain as over the 30-50 ceiling

assertions.name: explains-mechanism
assertions.check: States reputation is scored at domain level, so per-inbox safety is misleading

assertions.name: correct-remedy
assertions.check: Says add domains rather than adding mailboxes, which splits the same budget
